每条新连接轮流走不同中转，多线程下载、多设备同时用时带宽相加（两台 300M 约: Each new connection takes a different relay in turn, so bandwidth adds up for multi-threaded downloads and multiple devices (two 300M relays ≈ 600M); a single connection still uses only one relay. 每条转发规则就是一条线路：从入口进、经过中转或隧道、到落地，再从出口出去。新建一: Each forwarding rule is a line: in at the entry, through relays or tunnels, to the landing node, and out from the exit. Create a forward and you'll have one.
每条连接同时连上全部中转，平时只走第一台，其余连着不送；第一台停住几百毫秒内就由: Each connection connects to all relays at once but normally only uses the first; the others stay connected but idle. If the first stalls, the next takes over within a few hundred milliseconds without dropping or reconnecting.
每条连接同时连上全部中转，平时只走第一台；它停住几百毫秒内下一台就接手，连接不断: Each connection connects to all relays at once but normally uses only the first; if it stalls, the next takes over within a few hundred milliseconds without dropping or reconnecting.
每条连接拆开同时走全部中转，出口拼回来，单条连接也能用上几台中转的带宽之和；保存: Each connection is split across all relays at once and reassembled at the exit, so even a single connection can use the combined bandwidth of the relays; listed on the "Aggregation" tab after saving.
每条连接都拆到全部中转同时送，在出口拼回来；连接多的时候也一样把几台中转的带宽加: Every connection is split across all relays at once and reassembled at the exit; with many connections the relays' bandwidth also adds up.
每次切换都丢掉旧会话，下一个包改走新路径: Every switch drops old sessions and the next packet uses the new path
每次切换都断开旧连接，全部客户端立刻走新线路，可能重连: Every switch drops old connections so all clients move to the new line immediately, possibly reconnecting
